scripts.test: pnpm sidecar && pnpm -r test && (cd backend && go test -race ./...) && cargo test --manifest-path apps/clinic/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint:go: cd backend && go vet ./... && go run github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.15.0 run ./...
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --check --manifest-path apps/clinic/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/clinic/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
